name: The Chameleon
summary: Social deduction party game where all but one player know the secret word and must find the hidden Chameleon.
rules_text: Shuffle Topic Cards and place one visible. Roll dice to pick a coordinate. Deal Code Cards matching that coordinate to all players except one who gets the Chameleon card and sees nothing. In clockwise order each player says one word associated with the secret topic, with the Chameleon bluffing. After all have spoken players debate and simultaneously vote for who they think is Chameleon. If the most-voted player is not the Chameleon, Chameleon wins the round. If they are the Chameleon, Chameleon may guess the secret word; correct guess wins the round, otherwise the group wins. Optional scoring: Chameleon 2 points if not caught, 1 if caught but guesses correctly, others 2 if they catch and Chameleon fails. First to five points wins game.
rating_reason: One-vs-all word deduction, simple hidden roles
